expectedResult: REJECTED and IGNORED each persist once with reviewer and timestamp; neither decision mutates Bug business state or can be applied twice.
actualResult: Both consolidated variants disabled decisions immediately, but each returned to Pending review after browser refresh. Reject and Ignore therefore did not remain durably presented; business fields and workflow remained unchanged.
reviewBoundary: DonHV must review whether a new suggestion was incorrectly regenerated or the prior review state was lost before approving FAIL/Jira disposition.

Pending review returned after reload with decisions enabled.

Ignored state appeared immediately with decisions disabled.
Ignore variant returned to Pending review after reload.

issueClassification: product defect candidate - AI review decision not durable
limitations: The UI does not expose an immutable suggestion ID, so DonHV should confirm whether reopening regenerated a new suggestion versus lost the prior suggestion state; either behavior violates this case's same-decision persistence expectation.
